profile.headline: Staff Embedded Software Engineer at Carrier Energy
profile.summary: Senior Device Software Engineer with 15+ years of experience architecting and delivering high-performance embedded, distributed, and real-time systems across aerospace, defense, automotive, industrial, and medical device industries. Expert in C++ (modern standards), Rust, and Python with deep knowledge of RTOS, embedded Linux, containerization (Kubernetes, Podman, Docker), and cloud-based development (AWS, CI/CD, GitLab/GitHub, Bazel). Proven leader in system messaging architectures, hardware virtualization, signal processing, and safety-critical software design with hands-on contributions to satellite communications, avionics, autonomous vehicles, and medical imaging systems. Skilled at driving complex, cross-functional projects from requirements to deployment, with strong emphasis on performance optimization, regulatory compliance (DO-178C, ISO 13485, IEC 62304, ASPICE), cybersecurity, and test automation. Recognized for technical leadership, cross-domain expertise, and ability to bridge architecture with implementation in time-critical environments.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
Lead team in design of protobuf schemas used for inter-service control and alert messaging. This effort transitioned exclusive use of JSON messages to adoption of more performant protobuf messaging.

Lead Collaborative design activities for Message and Signal flow using digital whiteboard diagramming & docs in Confluence .

Lead team in implementing inter-container messages as protobuf strongly typed C++ interfaces; and as python service msgs.

Implemented protobuf control interfaces into C++ Services for real-time RF Waveform vector construction and Digital Signal Processing (DSP) into metadata wrapped Radio Frequency (RF) Encrypted Message Packets.

Designed and implemented Application-level message acknowledgments between subscriber & publisher. This effort made use of pre-allocating C++ std:: data structures to allow deterministic behavior in a time-constrained environment.

Doxygen comments in all code for comprehensive function & API documentation.
Code development performed within AWS EC2 instance Enclave

Leveraged LLM-generated test case code using segregated in-house LLM.

Employed Neural Autonomic Transport System (NATS) JetStream as Message Bus for deterministic real-time inter-container communication.

Queuing & Load Balancing are provided by NATS for time-constrained comms within Kubernetes (K8s) cluster.

Instrumented throughput latency mitigation via Wireshark PCAP & Prometheus metrics.

Analysis of metrics led to adjusting TCP windowing & MTU parameters toward maintaining message throughput within bounds.

Container pods mainly deployed with Podman in unit development, deployed via Helm in an integrated system. NATS and K8s Used for providing Scalability, & performance for time-constrained communication Satellite communications.

Designed & implemented an overall messaging orchestrator.

Automated GTest pass/fail verification of end to end message traffic through Helm continuously deployed services and connected RF HW, & emulators in CI.

positions.title: Senior Electromechanical Research Engineer
positions.description:
•	Led embedded software team in developing the UML Model-Based architecture, and embedded Bare Metal C++ implementation of Safety Critical Real-Time control software for mechatronic currency transporting ATM devices.
•	Our interdisciplinary team delivered mechatronic modules from concept to production ahead of schedule.
•	Provided software requirements for MCU and PCB components to hardware engineering.
•	Ensured the resolution of all software technical issues with electrical, and mechanical hardware engineering teams.
•	Designed and implemented robust Communication Drivers and encryption subsystem, on Motorola 68K /CPU32, in C and Motorola 68K Assembler.
•	Designed and developed portable preemptive Multitasking microcontroller Kernel for executing multithreaded designs on embedded modules deployed in Bare Metal applications without available sourced RTOS.
•	Utilized VxWorks in multi-module control.
•	Implemented over the network module firmware update facility.
•	Utilized heuristics for thermal state and available stored energy to manage motors and solenoids for fault tolerance and recovery, and for performance.
•	Utilized: NV memory, DAC, ADC, motors, sensors, and drivers for SPI and PWM.
•	Implemented Command protocol encryption, and key synchronization.
•	Designed Frameworks for Transactions/Commands, and for acquiring sensors, and actuating motors and solenoids.
•	Developed control software for electromechanical devices to handle and transport currency notes of value.
•	Developed Serial Communication with onboard and peripheral components, and CPU exception /interrupt handling. Utilized BDM interface for Debugging.
•	Developed module software Test Plan with QA verification engineering team.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Led development of communication and translation software interfaces to 3rd party physical security monitoring systems.
•	Led architecture and development of real-time UI for 7x24 security monitoring system, for critical event annunciation and hot device status UI updates, and operator actions synchronized on client/server multiple workstations.
•	Provided Safety Critical remote sensor monitoring, and Emergency response control systems, as well as highly responsive Premise Monitoring /Control servers and GUI’s.
•	Developed and maintained multi-platform libraries for synchronization, tasking, IPC, I/O, and Memory management and leak detection.
•	Led design and implementation of Secure Distributed SQL database RAM caching service with prioritized propagation, providing a memory mapped RDBMS adapter for disparate node entities.
•	Ported premise security and access control transaction processing applications to Win32.
•	Implemented Multi-Protocol Message Routing service.
•	Implemented Exception/error capture and reporting; Stack unwinding for exception examination, diagnostics, and code instrumentation.
•	Designed and implemented Multi-platform libraries for tasking and synchronization, I/O, and IPC.
•	Designed and implemented Physical Security simulators.
•	Developed Windows kernel communication device driver deployed to nodes with coprocessor. Utilized X86 Assembler and WinDbg for development.
•	Rendered graphical representation of remote alarms in floor plan context.
•	Assembled and Established team C++ Coding standards, and Defect Detection Guidelines.
•	Developed event annunciation pipelines using Java RMI, and resilient UDP streaming, and Exception reporting via SMTP, and Telephony.
•	Performed Ethernet frame and IP packet, analysis/sniffing; raw C socket and WinSock Development.
•	Extensively used Win32 API, as well as Services and service control management.
•	Authored Documentation for user applications, programming interfaces, and communication protocols.
